case: runs a coding turn with the expected runtime model and restores it after refresh
steps: Connect to a live server, open a coding workspace and set permission to Write. Confirm the runtime model, then send a prompt that asks the model to create a marker file, read it back and reply with a marker, approving tool use when asked. After the reply appears, refresh the page.
pass_condition: The runtime model matches the configured model; the assistant's marker reply appears and the turn settles; after refresh the workspace, the marker reply and the runtime-model label are still present; disconnecting returns the connect screen with the origin and a retained token.
protocol_methods: session/open; turn/start; session/hydrate; approval/requested; approval/respond; message/delta

case: keeps a background turn alive while a sibling Session is focused
steps: Connect to a live server and open a workspace, then send a prompt that briefly sleeps and writes a marker, approving tool use when asked. While it runs, create a new Session and wait for the original Session's row to show completion, then switch back to it and disconnect.
pass_condition: The background turn keeps running while the sibling Session is focused and completes without a connection-closed error; switching back shows the marker reply; the new Session appears and the original remains intact.
protocol_methods: session/open; turn/start; session/hydrate; approval/requested; approval/respond; session/list

case: discloses the other client's turn instead of claiming it
steps: Against a real server, connect, start a session, and send a message and wait for its reply. Then a second client opens the same session and starts a turn that never finishes, and the browser tries to send another message.
pass_condition: The session strip names the other client's turn instead of claiming it as ours, and a send the server refuses keeps the operator's text.

case: desktop notifications require Settings opt-in and stay silent while reading
steps: Enable desktop notifications in settings, leave the current session in view, and let a turn complete.
pass_condition: While the session is in view no desktop notification is raised and the document title is unchanged; toggling notifications back off shows the off state and persists that choice.

case: a hidden current Session completion notifies once and returning clears its badge
steps: Enable notifications, mark the current session as hidden, let a turn complete, then return to the app.
pass_condition: Exactly one notification is raised for the completion, the title gains a count prefix, and returning clears the badge and closes the notification.

case: denied desktop permission keeps tab counts working and Disconnect clears attention
steps: With desktop permission denied, enable notifications, close settings, hide the session and let a turn complete, then disconnect.
pass_condition: An alert says notifications are blocked and the toggle stays off; the title still gains the count while hidden, and disconnecting clears the count and raises no notification.

case: a background Session completing while another is selected signals and acknowledges on return
steps: Enable notifications, start a turn, create and select a second session, then switch back to the original session.
pass_condition: The original session shows a 'Completed in background' badge and the title gains a count with exactly one notification; selecting it removes the badge and clears the notification.

case: rejects invalid auth before the product shell is ever mounted
steps: Open the app, enter the server origin with an invalid auth token, and connect.
pass_condition: An alert reads 'Could not connect' with the connection title visible, and the product shell (navigation and workspace chooser) is never mounted.

case: accepts a profile-routable web identity but closes a scoped mismatch
steps: Open the app and send a session/open for a token that is routable to one profile with a matching session, then with a mismatched profile.
pass_condition: The matching identity opens and reports its session id and active profile; the mismatched one is closed with code 1008 and reason auth_expired.

case: binds a cross-profile launch to the resolved profile before open
steps: Connect with an admin token, add a cross-profile workspace, and start a new session scoped to the review profile.
pass_condition: The composer appears and the session/open frame for the new session carries profile review with a session id beginning review:api:web-.

case: refresh shows the interrupted turn with ${canonicalReplay ? "complete canonical replay" : "legacy terminal state"}
steps: Open the client, connect to the server, start a workspace, and send a prompt whose turn the server interrupts after streaming one finding. Reload the page. Runs once with the canonical replay chunk and once without.
pass_condition: After reload the timeline shows "Turn stopped", the Stop control is gone, and the composer is enabled; with canonical replay the prompt and the preserved finding reappear once and the connection-closed message shows, otherwise the legacy "stopped before it completed" message shows instead.

case: holds twelve browser turns and three browser-started native peers on one pooled socket
steps: Connect and start one workspace, then run twelve browser turns on it, opening a fresh sibling session between each; finally open the session-peers dialog and start three peers.
pass_condition: All fifteen turns share one pooled socket, each peer session opens and kicks off exactly once on that socket with a unique turn id, and every turn is tracked as active for that workspace.

case: an external-held session restores uploaded media and reasoning for an explicit retry
steps: Connect and start a workspace that is held by another client, open its advanced settings and confirm the foreign-holder notice. Attach an image and send a prompt, see it refused with the draft kept, inspect the retained image, then use Resume chat to retry.
pass_condition: The refused send shows the not-sent notice, keeps the draft, and sends no release or turn start; the attached image is still listed as uploaded; the retry sends exactly one turn start carrying the draft, the same media and reasoning high, clears the composer and drops the attachment.

case: Resume chat and an owned seat release control before sending once
steps: Connect and start an idle handover workspace, send a prompt and see it refused with the draft kept. Use Resume chat to take the seat and confirm a Release seat control appears, close the pane, then send from that owned seat.
pass_condition: Resume chat sends the draft as exactly one turn start; taking the seat enables a Release seat control; the next ordinary send releases that proof and starts once with the new prompt and an empty composer.

case: a late collision cannot replace newer text or images, then restores the complete draft
steps: Connect and start a workspace, attach an image and send a prompt whose admission is refused as a collision after you have already changed the draft with a new reasoning level, a new image and newer text. Then remove the added image and inspect the returned draft.
pass_condition: The refusal shows the session-busy notice and keeps the newer text plus both the original uploaded image and the new un-uploaded selection, leaving the original prompt unsent; removing the new image restores the original upload and shows the original draft; a later local command does not send it.

case: fails closed for an unknown command and sends no model input
steps: Connect to the fixture server and start a workspace session, then type an unknown slash command and send it.
pass_condition: The app says the command is unavailable and that nothing was sent to the model, the prompt box is left empty, and no turn is started.

case: opens Activity and inspects the current task in TaskDetailDialog
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, then run /activity to open the Activity dialog that scans server-owned tasks. Inspect the current session's task, which opens the task detail view.
pass_condition: The Activity dialog lists the server-owned task and offers Inspect; inspecting opens a task-output dialog with a close control and the task's scoped output or artifacts (not a raw payload dump, not a Trajectory surface), and no turn is started.

case: keeps /sessions refocus stable on the active Session via sidebar search
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, then run /sessions. Repeat the command while refocusing the prompt box between calls.
pass_condition: The sidebar session search field takes focus with no dialog opening, the active session row stays selected, and no new turn is started across repeated invocations.

case: keeps the confirmed fork receipt across parent refresh and opens the exact child without stealing focus
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, send a prompt and wait for the reply, then run /fork, name the new conversation, and create the fork while the parent history refresh is held.
pass_condition: The dialog shows the fork receipt and the parent stays selected; exactly one fork request carries the parent id and new name; the child opens only when chosen, with the source then the child hydrated in order and no extra turn started.

case: keeps the workspace restore receipt through canonical refresh without rewinding its conversation
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, send a prompt and wait for the reply, then run /undo, pick a snapshot, and confirm the workspace restore while the parent history refresh is held.
pass_condition: The dialog shows the workspace-restore receipt, the conversation is unchanged, and the trace shows snapshot listings and exactly one restore for the session with no conversation rewind.

case: keeps the rewind receipt and restores only the owning prompt draft after canonical refresh
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, send two prompts and wait for each reply, then run /rewind, choose the first checkpoint, and confirm the conversation rewind while the history refresh is held.
pass_condition: The dialog shows the rewind receipt, the conversation drops back to before the first prompt, the owning prompt text returns to the composer, and the trace shows one rollback of two turns with no workspace restore.

case: queues a held gather synthesis only on busy A while B is selected and keeps blackboard refresh read-only
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, stage a peer from the peers dialog, start a held turn on the first session, then queue a /gather on it twice while a second session is selected. Release the held work and return to the first session.
pass_condition: Exactly one peer gather is sent for the owning session, the queued synthesis runs only on that session, and the second session's view shows no gathered peer results.

case: reports an empty filtered gather without sending synthesis or opening a Session
steps: Connect and start a workspace session, then run /gather against a peer that is not staged on the blackboard.
pass_condition: The app reports that no peers are staged, exactly one gather request for the missing slug is sent, no turn is started, and no second session is opened.

case: closed-tab drafts restore only for the authenticated principal and Forget clears that principal
steps: Open the client and start a session, then type unsent text in two tabs. Close both tabs and reopen them so each restores its own draft; later Forget the saved connection for one tab and reopen it.
pass_condition: Each reopened tab restores only its own owner's draft; after Forget that tab's draft is gone while the other owner's survives, and no draft tokens or owner text remain in browser storage.
web_only_reason: Unsent-draft persistence is browser localStorage/sessionStorage keyed by the connected principal; there is no native-client equivalent.

case: a delayed principal lookup preserves newly typed text and cannot restore a retired identity
steps: Save a draft, close the tab, and reopen it while the identity lookup is held. Type new text before the identity resolves, let it resolve, then disconnect and reconnect as a different principal.
pass_condition: The newly typed text survives, no retired identity's draft is restored over it, and the text persists across a reload.
web_only_reason: Draft restoration is scoped to the browser-stored principal in localStorage/sessionStorage; no native surface is involved.

case: failed Forget stays visible across identity edits until saved data can actually be cleared
steps: Start a session, type a draft, make browser storage read-only, then Forget the server from Settings. Change the auth identity and keep trying to clear until storage becomes writable.
pass_condition: A 'Saved data could not be cleared' alert stays visible while clearing keeps failing and disappears only once the saved data is actually removed; the stored draft never silently returns.
web_only_reason: Clearing saved connection data is a browser localStorage/sessionStorage operation with no native equivalent.

case: denied storage getters still allow an in-memory connection and readable cleanup feedback
steps: Deny access to browser storage, then start a session and type into the prompt box.
pass_condition: The client still connects and edits in memory, shows a readable 'Saved data could not be cleared' alert, warns before leaving, and logs no page errors.
web_only_reason: Exercises blocked browser storage getters (localStorage/sessionStorage) with an in-memory fallback; there is no native equivalent.

case: a 51st unsent draft evicts the oldest, stays saved, and never blocks navigation
steps: Start a session, pre-fill fifty stored drafts, reload, then type a fifty-first unsent draft.
pass_condition: The new draft is saved, exactly one old draft is evicted, no capacity warning or leave-guard appears, navigation stays open, and a reload restores the fifty-first draft.
web_only_reason: Draft capacity and eviction are browser localStorage cache mechanics with no native equivalent.

case: a draft typed while identity loads is never the capacity eviction victim
steps: Pre-fill fifty stored drafts, reload while the identity lookup is held, and type a fresh draft before the lookup resolves.
pass_condition: The fresh text is kept, the eviction takes an older stored draft instead, and the prompt box still holds the fresh text.
web_only_reason: Draft capacity and eviction are browser localStorage cache mechanics with no native equivalent.

case: copies the conversation as Markdown from the server's history
steps: Start a workspace, send the fixture prompt and wait for the reply to finish streaming, then press Copy as Markdown in the chat header and read the clipboard.
pass_condition: The control reads Copied and the clipboard holds a Markdown transcript that begins with the workspace title and a Workspace line and carries User and Assistant sections with the assistant's Markdown verbatim, including its table row and fenced code block, and no incomplete marker.

case: says there is nothing to copy for a conversation with no messages yet
steps: Start a brand-new workspace and press Copy as Markdown before sending anything.
pass_condition: The control reads Nothing to copy and no transcript is placed on the clipboard.

case: keeps the phone header for the workspace title: no copy button there
steps: Open the client at a 390-by-844 phone viewport, start a workspace and look at the chat header.
pass_condition: The phone header shows the workspace title and the copy-as-Markdown control is absent.
web_only_reason: A responsive-layout assertion about which header control renders at a phone viewport.

case: shows files the agent delivers, previews images, downloads them, and keeps them on reload
steps: Start a workspace, have the agent deliver an image with no caption and a presentation file with a caption, preview the image, download the file, then reload the page.
pass_condition: Both deliveries appear as attachments, the image renders at its real size, the caption text shows, downloading saves the file under its own name with its fixture contents, no server path is shown as message text, and a reload restores both attachments.

case: says a file could not be loaded instead of failing silently
steps: Start a workspace and have the agent deliver a file, then make the file endpoint refuse access and load the attachment.
pass_condition: The attachment still appears and reports that the file could not be loaded rather than failing silently.

case: diff syntax and word marks preserve inert, selectable text in both themes and on mobile
steps: Start a session and send a message, open the change review, then look at the diff in light and dark mode and at a narrow mobile width.
pass_condition: The diff shows the exact replacement lines with highlighted changed words and no images or scripts; the text is selectable and scrollable; keyword colors differ per theme and from the plain text; and closing the review returns focus to the review button.

case: large previews remain complete and use the plain-text performance fallback
steps: Start a session, send a message, and open the change review for a preview with five hundred added lines.
pass_condition: The review reports that the large preview is shown as plain text with all lines included, every line is present, no syntax colors are applied, and closing the review hides it.

case: a missing optional diff grammar retains original text and word marks
steps: Start a session and send a message, then open the change review while the optional TypeScript grammar chunk is blocked.
pass_condition: The diff still shows the original text with changed-word marks and no syntax colors, and no page errors are logged.

case: reload restores exact unsent text without dispatching it, and sent drafts stay cleared
steps: Start a session and type unsent text with leading, trailing, and emoji content, then reload. Send it and reload again.
pass_condition: The reload restores the exact text without starting a turn; after sending, the box is empty, exactly one turn was started, and a further reload keeps it empty.
web_only_reason: Unsent-draft persistence is browser localStorage behavior with no native-client equivalent.

case: a rejected draft storage write preserves editing and warns before text can be lost
steps: Start a session, type a saved draft, then make browser storage reject writes and removals and keep editing.
pass_condition: Editing continues, a 'Draft changes could not be saved' status is shown, leaving warns until the draft is safe, and no page errors are logged.
web_only_reason: Draft-save failure handling is browser localStorage behavior with no native-client equivalent.

case: renders a healthy EXTERNAL disclosure from the real empty terminal operations page
steps: Connect to the server, open the driver-discovery workspace, then open the 'External controller' disclosure and confirm it with the keyboard.
pass_condition: Exactly one discovery walk is sent carrying the session id and the operations flag (two parameters, no topic) and answering with a complete empty operations page; opening the disclosure by keyboard reveals the synthetic driver id with epoch 7 and revision 42 and sends no control or model request.

case: renders an INTERNAL disclosure with no binding rows
steps: Connect to the server and open the driver-discovery workspace configured with an internal controller.
pass_condition: Exactly one disclosure appears headed 'Internal controller' and it shows no binding rows: no 'No active lease' line and no synthetic driver id.

case: holds ONLY the first walk of a workspace: same-workspace sibling completes while A stays held
steps: Connect to a workspace whose first driver walk is held by the server, then start a sibling session in the same workspace.
pass_condition: The held workspace shows no disclosure while its first walk is unanswered; the sibling in the same workspace completes a walk and mounts the 'External controller' disclosure, and releasing the first walk delivers its original reply.

case: A/B: exact synthetic driver ID per selected Session; releasing held A never leaks into a selected B
steps: Connect to a held workspace, let a sibling session complete and become selected, then release the held session and switch back to it.
pass_condition: Each selected session's disclosure shows its own exact synthetic driver id and never the other's, both before and after the held session is released.

case: does not admit a walk when ${variant} capability is withheld
steps: For a server that withholds the driver method and again for one that withholds the external-driver feature, connect and open the driver-discovery workspace (runs once per withheld capability).
pass_condition: No discovery walk is ever sent and no disclosure mounts for either withheld capability.

case: surfaces a typed refusal and never mounts a disclosure for it
steps: Connect and open the driver-discovery workspace configured to answer the walk with a typed refusal.
pass_condition: A walk is sent, its reply carries error -32041 with kind driver_scope_mismatch, and no disclosure mounts.

case: rejects a MALFORMED disclosure binding at the strict decode boundary
steps: Connect and open the driver-discovery workspace whose binding carries a non-integer epoch.
pass_condition: The walk is sent but the malformed binding is rejected at the strict decode boundary: no disclosure renders and the composer stays usable.

case: transitions healthy -> refused across a transport reconnect on the SAME record
steps: Connect and open a healthy workspace, then have the server flip that same session to refused and force a transport reconnect.
pass_condition: The previously complete inventory collapses to non-complete; the new walk returns the typed refusal (-32041, driver_scope_mismatch) and the disclosure unmounts.

case: transitions malformed -> healthy across a transport reconnect on the SAME record
steps: Connect and open a healthy workspace, damage the same session's binding and reconnect, then undo the damage and reconnect again.
pass_condition: After the damage the strict decoder rejects the binding so the disclosure unmounts; after the repair the disclosure re-mounts showing the session's own synthetic driver id.

case: observes a deterministic discovery request: one walk, real params, terminal page
steps: Connect to the server, open the default driver-discovery workspace, and watch the single discovery request.
pass_condition: Exactly one walk is observed carrying the session id and the operations flag, whose reply is an empty complete operations page (mode external, recovery none, epoch 7, revision 42, lease expiry 0).

case: approval shortcuts ignore modified keys and IME composition
steps: Connect and open a workspace, then request an approval and wait for the approval dialog to take focus. Press Ctrl+Y, Alt+N, Meta+S and IME-composing Y presses, then a plain Y.
pass_condition: The modified and composing presses leave the dialog visible and send no decision; the plain Y hides the dialog and sends exactly one approval response.

case: long approval remains readable and actionable in a short phone viewport
steps: Connect at a 320 by 360 phone viewport and request an approval whose body and diff are very long. Step focus through every control and scroll the approval body, then decline.
pass_condition: Every control stays within the viewport and reachable, the body scrolls fully to its end, and declining hides the dialog.

case: connection actions can be reached by scrolling at 320×320
steps: Open the web client at a 320 by 320 viewport, enter a server address and a wrong token, scroll, and connect so it fails. Correct the token, scroll again, and connect.
pass_condition: The Connect control scrolls into view and stays reachable; the wrong token shows the connection error; the corrected token reveals the workspace-path field.

case: long questions retain free text and selections after a failed response
steps: Connect at a short phone viewport and request a three-question prompt. Select Full for each question, type an extra free-text answer, and submit so the first attempt is rejected. Scroll the dialog and submit again.
pass_condition: The failed attempt shows the retry message while the typed free text and every selection are retained; the dialog scrolls to its end; the retry sends the identical response payload.

case: composer preserves IME confirmation and multiline edits around commands
steps: Connect and type a slash to open the command list, then confirm that composing ArrowDown and Enter presses change neither the draft nor the selection. Close the list, type a mixed-script line, and use arrow keys plus Alt+Enter and Ctrl+J to insert newlines. Send with a composing Enter, then a plain Enter.
pass_condition: Composing keystrokes neither edit nor submit; Alt+Enter and Ctrl+J insert the expected newlines; the composing Enter sends nothing and the plain Enter sends exactly one prompt and clears the composer.

case: question radio selection keeps backward Tab inside its dialog
steps: Connect and request the verification-depth question, then select Full. Move focus with Shift+Tab, Tab, ArrowUp and Shift+Tab around the dialog, and finish by answering with Continue so the turn clears.
pass_condition: Backward Tab keeps focus inside the dialog, moving to the Continue control and back to the selection; ArrowUp switches the selection to Fast; Continue closes the dialog.

case: phone search and view menus consume Escape before the sessions drawer
steps: Connect, open a 390 by 640 phone viewport, and open the sessions drawer. Open the session search, press Escape once while composing and once plainly, then open the view-options menu and press Escape twice.
pass_condition: A composing Escape leaves the search open; a plain Escape closes the search and returns focus to its trigger; Escape closes the menu and then the drawer, returning focus to each trigger in turn.

case: code copy reports rejected and missing clipboard APIs without losing the code
steps: Open a workspace whose transcript already contains a TypeScript code block. Press the copy-code control once while the browser refuses the clipboard write, once while the clipboard API is missing, and once with a working clipboard.
pass_condition: The first two attempts show a could-not-copy alert while the code stays readable and no uncaught page error is recorded, and the third attempt shows Copied and clears the alert.

case: sidebar native buttons keep Enter behavior and search Escape restores its trigger
steps: Start a workspace, hover its sidebar entry and press Enter on the new-session button to create a second Session. Open the session search, type a query, then press Escape and Tab.
pass_condition: The new-session button responds to Enter and a second Session appears, search narrows the list to two entries, Escape closes search and focuses its trigger, and Tab moves focus on to the session view options control.

case: tree focus follows a collapsed parent and no longer references a removed search row
steps: Focus the workspaces-and-sessions tree and move through it with the arrow keys, collapsing a parent and expanding it again. Open session search, focus its results, press Home and then close the search.
pass_condition: The tree's reported active row always names a row that exists, collapsing the parent leaves one visible row with the active row matching it, and closing search never leaves the tree pointing at a result row that has been removed.
web_only_reason: Pure browser focus bookkeeping: tree active-row tracking has no native counterpart.

case: 360-message history stays readable while new output streams and unsafe Markdown stays inert
steps: Open a workspace whose transcript is 360 messages long, page back through the earlier messages, scroll to a middle entry, then send a prompt and let new output stream while switching to another Session and back.
pass_condition: Earlier-message paging loads in steps up to 360 entries without moving the anchored row, the reader's position survives streaming and Session switches, unsafe links and remote images in the final entry stay inert, and wide code and tables scroll inside their own boxes at phone and small-window sizes.
protocol_methods: session/open; session/hydrate; session/messages_page; turn/start; projection/envelope; message/delta; turn/completed

case: Diff review keeps long headings and file content inside the narrow viewport
steps: On a 320-by-480 viewport, run a turn to completion and open the review-changes surface for a change with a very long title and a deeply nested file path. Expand a file, scroll its diff sideways, then close the review.
pass_condition: The review surface and its close control stay inside the viewport width, collapsing by click and expanding by Enter both work, the diff lines scroll horizontally, and closing the review returns focus to the review action.

case: a missing optional syntax grammar leaves readable and copyable plain code
steps: Open a workspace whose transcript contains a Python code block while the optional Python syntax-highlighting asset fails to load. Look at the block and press its copy control.
pass_condition: The code renders as plain readable text, the copy-code control stays enabled, and no uncaught page error is recorded.
web_only_reason: About the web client's optional syntax-grammar asset load and its plain-code fallback; no native counterpart.

case: task output and artifact controls fit a short phone viewport with long titles
steps: On a 320-by-480 viewport, open the trajectory list and pick the task whose title is very long. Read its output, open a report artifact, load more of it, then close the panel.
pass_condition: The task panel and its close control stay inside the viewport, the long title does not push controls off screen, loading more artifact content keeps the panel usable and reveals the completion text, and closing hides the panel.

case: rejects same-base foreign-topic ${kind} and terminal traffic without settling or poisoning the ordinary owner
steps: Connect and open a workspace, send a prompt and capture its exact Session and turn ids, then queue a follow-up. Inject interaction frames and terminal traffic on a foreign topic and confirm nothing surfaces; then inject an owner-topic request and answer it, and let the queued prompt drain.
pass_condition: Foreign-topic and terminal frames never show a dialog and never send a response; the owner-topic interaction appears and is answered with the exact Session and interaction id and no topic field; the queued prompt drains on the same Session with a new turn; the hydration count is unchanged.
protocol_methods: session/open; turn/start; approval/requested; approval/respond; user_question/requested; user_question/respond

case: responds to a parked approval from the owning Session with exact ids
steps: Connect and open a workspace, send a prompt so Session A raises an approval, then create sibling Session B. Return to A and accept the restored approval.
pass_condition: A's approval is restored only under A and stays hidden under B; exactly one approval response is sent carrying A's Session and the request's approval id; only A's Session receives the completed terminal.

case: restores and resolves a parked question on its owning Session with exact ids
steps: Connect and open a workspace, send a prompt so Session A raises a structured question, then create sibling Session B. Return to A, select Full, and continue.
pass_condition: The question is restored only under A and stays hidden under B; exactly one question response is sent with A's Session, the request's question id and the Full selection; only A's Session receives the completed terminal.

case: keeps three concurrent parked questions bound to their Sessions and resolves them out of order
steps: Connect and open a workspace, raise a question on Session A, then create Sessions B and C and raise a question on each so all three park together. Switch among all three without answering, then answer out of order: B, A, then C.
pass_condition: Three distinct Sessions, questions and turns each park their own question; switching alone never answers, cancels or interrupts; the three responses go out in B, A, C order, each correlated to its own request id and answering its own question; each Session receives exactly one completed terminal for its own original turn.

case: opens, navigates, and executes the command palette by keyboard only
steps: Connect and start a workspace with the keyboard, focus the composer, and type a slash to open the command palette. Move the selection with ArrowDown and ArrowUp (wrapping at both ends), Tab into the options, Escape back to the composer, then filter to /theme and run it with Enter.
pass_condition: The palette opens with the selection following the arrow keys and wrapping; the textbox keeps focus and exposes its active option; Escape closes the palette; running /theme opens Browser preferences and never starts a turn.

case: switches sessions by keyboard and preserves sidebar focus order
steps: Connect and start a workspace with the keyboard, create a second Session with Enter, then walk the sidebar rows with Home, ArrowDown and ArrowUp and switch back to the first Session with Enter.
pass_condition: The second Session appears; the tree's active row follows the arrow keys without gaps; Enter switches the active row without reopening the Session or starting a turn.

case: Esc closes the palette inertly and interrupts only a live turn
steps: Connect and start a workspace with the keyboard, open the palette and press Escape, then press a bare Escape with no turn active. Hold the next terminal, send a prompt so a turn is live, and press Escape.
pass_condition: Escaping the palette closes it without interrupting; a bare Escape with no live turn does nothing; with a held live turn, Escape sends exactly one interrupt for that turn.

case: Alt+A focuses the pending approval panel and announces when none waits
steps: Connect and start a workspace. With no approval pending, press Alt+A from a non-input focus, then raise an approval, move focus away, and press Alt+A again.
pass_condition: With no approval pending, Alt+A announces that no approval is waiting and shows no panel; once an approval is raised, Alt+A focuses that panel.

case: Alt+D focuses Fleet's capability notice; suppressed inside inputs
steps: Connect and start a workspace. Press Alt+D with focus in the composer, then from a non-input focus press Alt+D to enter Fleet. Open the Session settings dialog and press Alt+D again.
pass_condition: The composer press does nothing; the second press reveals Fleet's capability notice, focuses it, and shows no Start form; an open dialog suppresses the chord.

case: Alt+P toggles the peer dock fold, expanding and collapsing symmetrically
steps: Connect and start a workspace, then stage two peers through the peer dialog using only the keyboard. Press Alt+P from a non-input focus to collapse the dock, then press Alt+P again to expand it.
pass_condition: With no peers the dock is absent; after staging two, the dock shows an expanded control with two rows; Alt+P collapses it to a single collapsed control with no rows, and a second Alt+P restores the two rows.

case: streaming turn stays under the long-frame budget
steps: Open a session, begin observing long animation frames, and stream a turn to completion.
pass_condition: No long animation frame during the streaming phase exceeds the 200 ms budget.

case: five themes and live language/Vim changes preserve two busy Sessions, queued text and local images without RPC
steps: Open the client and start two Sessions in one workspace. Hold a turn in each, queue a second prompt in the first and attach a local image, then cycle all five themes and switch language and Vim mode while both turns are still running.
pass_condition: Each theme repaints the app to its documented surface and accent colour, language and Vim changes apply live, the other Session's draft and the queued prompt and image survive, and no extra server request is made while preferences are switched.

case: language changes translate retained ${kind} controls without translating Core content or changing its owner
steps: Start two Sessions, switch the language to Chinese, then raise an approval (or question) request in the first. Switch to the second Session, set the language back to English and return to the still-open request.
pass_condition: The takeover's own buttons and headings follow the active language while the Core-supplied prompt text keeps its original wording, displaying the request sends no response, and answering it once returns exactly one response bound to the same Session and request id.
protocol_methods: session/open; session/hydrate; turn/start; approval/requested; approval/respond; user_question/requested; user_question/respond

case: Vim editing keeps Insert Escape and pending-operator Escape local, while Normal Enter uses the existing FIFO
steps: Enable Vim mode, start a turn and hold it running, then edit the draft: escape out of Insert mode, start an operator and escape it, apply a small Normal-mode edit, and send from Normal mode while the first turn is still running.
pass_condition: Escaping from Insert and from a pending operator only changes mode and never interrupts the running turn, the Normal-mode edit applies to the draft, and sending from Normal mode queues the prompt so it starts only once the held turn is released.

case: Vim focus/Session ownership, Unicode deletion, IME and clipboard modifiers never edit another draft or hijack native keys
steps: Enable Vim mode, type a draft containing an emoji in the first Session, start an operator, switch to a new Session and edit its own draft, then switch back. Also fire composing, Escape and clipboard-modifier key presses at the composer.
pass_condition: Each Session keeps its own draft and cursor, Unicode deletion removes the intended character, composing and modifier key presses are left for the browser to handle, and no turn is started or interrupted.

case: bare Normal Escape interrupts only the selected owner, while Vim changes preserve the other busy Session
steps: Enable Vim mode and hold a turn in each of two Sessions. Select the first Session, focus its composer and press Escape in Normal mode, then check the second Session.
pass_condition: Exactly one interrupt is sent, bound to the selected Session and its turn, the second Session's turn keeps running, and no extra turns are started.

case: only explicit save persists display preferences; reload restores preferences and the separate draft without storing credentials

pass_condition: Nothing is written to browser storage until the explicit save, the saved record holds exactly theme, language and Vim mode, the auth token never appears in storage, and after reload the saved preferences, the language attribute and the separate draft are all restored.
web_only_reason: Display preferences live in browser local storage and draft recovery is browser-local; the workspace connection is the only native touch.

steps: Start a workspace, open Settings from the navigation, then press Escape.
pass_condition: The Settings surface is described to assistive technology as a modal, Escape removes it, and keyboard focus returns to the Settings button that opened it.

case: canceling a provider confirmation preserves Settings at ${viewport.width}px

pass_condition: Each aside text appears only under its owning Session and never under the other; switching Sessions preserves the unsent draft; exactly two aside frames are sent and no turn is started.

pass_condition: Inspectors bind to the selected Session's exact id; a read held for A never renders under B; turn state reads as unknown under B and completed under A; malformed turn forms are refused; exactly two turn-state reads and one remembered-scope read are sent and only one turn started.

case: a dropped native steer returns once to its owning FIFO while a different Session is selected

Start sibling Session B, type an unsent draft there, and drop two steer attempts aimed at A. Switch to A (one queued item), turn steering off, queue an ordinary successor, switch back to B, release A, and watch A run in order.
pass_condition: A dropped steer re-queues once to its owning Session, interrupts nothing, and produces two steer-dropped notices; A runs three distinct turns in FIFO order while B keeps its draft; no interrupt is sent.

Release A, interrupt the agent, and request two parallel agents through the form.

case: goal notifications admit arbitrary-base strictly-increasing generations and drop stale or foreign owners

case: native monitors create, list, pause, resume and delete through typed receipts
steps: Connect and open the monitors panel, then create a polling monitor with a name and a probe command. Pause it, resume it, and finally delete it.
pass_condition: Create, pause, resume and delete each settle a typed success receipt carrying the exact session and monitor id, with status active, then paused, then active, and a pause reason of user; the row disappears after delete; no turn starts.

case: native fixed-loop fire now sends one typed manual receipt without changing loop status
steps: Connect and open the loops panel and create a fixed-interval loop. Use that loop row's Fire control.
pass_condition: Exactly one fire request is sent with the exact loop id; its receipt reports success, a top-level queued status, the loop itself still active, and a queued fire with reason LoopFire; the panel status names the fired loop id; pause stays available and no turn starts.

case: explains missing authentication while preserving password privacy and IME entry

pass_condition: The composing Enter does nothing and the Connect control stays; the plain Enter shows the auth-required error with no workspace chooser; the token field stays a password field until revealed, and hiding restores the masking.

case: starts a first workspace with the keyboard and focuses the useful field when adding another
steps: Connect with the keyboard and start a first workspace from the workspace-path field, then type an unsent draft in the composer. Open the Add-workspace dialog and press Escape.
pass_condition: The first workspace opens and the composer keeps the draft; the Add-workspace dialog focuses its path field, and Escape closes it without losing the draft.

case: keeps an in-flight workspace creation visible when Escape or the backdrop is used
steps: Connect with the keyboard and start a first workspace. Open Add workspace and start a second workspace whose resolution is held so the Starting control is disabled. Press Escape and click the backdrop, then let the creation finish.
pass_condition: While creation is pending, Escape and the backdrop do not close the dialog; once the held resolution is released the dialog closes and the new workspace appears.

pass_condition: The used-link message and its fresh-link next step are shown, the origin is prefilled, and the manual token still reaches the workspace gate.

case: an expired code and a malformed link each get their own bounded copy

pass_condition: Each gets its own bounded explanation and next step, the origin stays prefilled, and the fixture's attempt budget is left untouched.

case: an octos origin off this computer is refused without a request

pass_condition: The client refuses the origin with its own copy before sending any request, and the refused address is not prefilled into the form.

case: the paired token survives only this tab until Forget

case: a server that 404s /pair/info is simply pairing not supported

pass_condition: No alert and no discovery offer are shown, and the manual form still reaches the workspace gate.

pass_condition: The remembered server offers itself once by name, with no error alert.

case: staging renders idle, then a peer turn flips the row to live

case: a refused RECEIPT renders the typed peer_control_refused refusal

case: peer dock shows the staged roster and keeps approval actions fail-closed
